description: Euronext listed equities (daily list from live.euronext.com): lists or searches shares on one Euronext market by MIC code (e.g. XAMS Amsterdam, XPAR Paris) and returns name, ISIN, ticker, currency, last close, volume and turnover. End-of-day data from the last trading day; not real-time. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

mic.description: Market MIC code, 4 letters, e.g. XAMS, XPAR, XBRU, XLIS

q.description: Optional name, ticker or ISIN filter, up to 40 characters

name: finance_euronext_equities
title: Euronext listed equities: lists or searches shares on one
